intro: Tuscany NX is designed for those who stay at the table longer. With soft cushioning, a curved backrest, and a sturdy frame, it’s comfort that lasts past dinner.

features.title: Cushioning that comforts, not sinks
features.text: The foam-padded seat and back offer the perfect balance of softness and structure—so you can stay present at the table longer.

features.title: Upholstered for a polished finish
features.text: Our fabric upholstery adds a soft texture that feels welcoming and visually refined.

features.title: A curve that feels natural
features.text: The ergonomic backrest supports your posture gently, following the shape of your spine for all-day ease.

features.title: We gave it a foundation that lasts
features.text: The black powder-coated metal understructure adds strength and stability to every sit—offering you lasting support with a sleek, modern edge.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
